message.content: In the month of May, Hailey Johnson offered several special offerings at her bakery. A notable event was a free baking class hosted on a weekend, which Li Hua enthusiastically attended and expressed interest in participating in more. Additionally, there was a bread-tasting event scheduled on a Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM, which was planned to gather feedback from customers. These special events highlighted Hailey's commitment to engaging with her customers and introducing new experiences to enhance their bakery visits.
